result_summary.title: Critical: Mass payment declines in ANZ production
result_summary.description: We are currently experiencing a high volume of payment declines through the Billing Disputes Handler in the ANZ production environment. As of 10 minutes ago, approximately 1,281 active transactions have been rejected unexpectedly. There are no changes to our card processing logic on our end. This is a critical blocker preventing us from collecting revenue. Please investigate the decline reason codes immediately and advise if this is a regional gateway issue.
